$comment: Ticket 035: generic (non Child Development) pre-consult intake. `fields` = the ElevenLabs agent's data collection items (docs/elevenlabs-generic-intake-agent.md); `brief` = the JSON Gemini returns for the generic_intake_brief report (zod mirror: lib/intake/generic.ts GenericIntakeBriefSchema). The medicine/allergy check against the 021 health profile is added by the server (health_check), not by the model.

fields.label: Consent given
fields.description: The parent agreed to talk to an AI assistant and to the call being recorded and summarised for the provider

fields.label: Reason for visit
fields.description: Why the parent booked this visit, in their own words

fields.label: History
fields.description: When the problem started, how it changed, earlier treatment, relevant past illnesses or operations

fields.label: Current concerns
fields.description: What worries the parent most right now

fields.label: Current medicines
fields.description: Medicines, supplements or remedies the child takes now, with dose if known

fields.label: Allergies
fields.description: Known allergies and the reaction, or that there are none

fields.label: Questions for the provider
fields.description: Questions the parent wants to ask at the visit

fields.label: Urgent warning sign mentioned
fields.description: The parent described an emergency or urgent warning sign (the agent then advised calling 108 or 112)
